channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Delhi’s EV Policy 2.0 Proposes ₹50,000 Incentive for First 1,000 Petrol, Diesel Car Retrofits
item.description: Delhi’s draft EV Policy 2.0 proposes a ₹50,000 incentive to encourage retrofitting petrol and diesel cars into electric vehicles to cut pollution.

item.title: Agrifields Boss Amit Gupta Facing Criminal Investigation In India for Alleged Company Fraud and Forgery in 700 Crore Scandal
item.description: Kolkata Police have filed an FIR alleging fraudulent share transfers, forged records, and financial misconduct linked to businessman Amit Gupta and Sunland Projects.

item.title: Delhi Triple Murder Case: Man, 25, Surrenders After Allegedly Poisoning Prasad, Strangling Mother, Two Siblings
item.description: A Delhi man surrendered after allegedly poisoning his family with Dhatura and strangling them due to debt.

item.title: Delhi Anti-Encroachment Drive Near Faiz-e-Elahi Mosque Turns Violent; Five Cops Injured in Stone Pelting
item.description: Five officers were injured as violent clashes erupted during an MCD demolition drive near a Delhi mosque.

item.title: Curfew Imposed in Southern Nepal After Mosque Vandalism Sparks Communal Protests, Police Investigation Underway
item.description: A curfew was imposed in a southern Nepal border city after mosque vandalism led to rival Hindu and Muslim protests, raising concerns over communal harmony.

item.title: Nestlé Recalls Baby Formula Products in 25 Countries Due To Potentially Dangerous Toxin Contamination
item.description: Nestlé has initiated a massive global recall of baby formula products following detection of a dangerous toxin.

item.title: Trump Pressures India With 50% Tariffs Over Russian Oil, Says PM Modi Is “Not Happy”
item.description: Trump has linked steep US tariffs on Indian goods to New Delhi’s Russian oil imports, intensifying trade tensions despite diplomatic ties.

item.title: UP Electoral Roll: 2.89 Crore Names Dropped, Voter Count Falls to 12.55 Crore After ECI Revision, Objections Open Till Feb 6
item.description: Uttar Pradesh's electoral roll shrinks by 2.89 crore names post-SIR, targeting deceased, migrants, and duplicates, with objections open until 6 February.

item.title: Indian Woman Working in US Allegedly Found Murdered; Prime Suspect Who Fled to India Arrested in Tamil Nadu
item.description: A Hyderabad woman was found dead in Maryland allegedly after visiting a former housemate to recover a loan.

item.title: Taiwan Launches Massive Sea Search After F-16V Fighter Crash Leaves Pilot Missing During Night Drill
item.description: A routine night training mission ended in crisis as Taiwan’s F-16V jet crashed into the sea, leaving its pilot missing.
